SectionObject.Title: Mobility
SectionObject.Text1: This visualization shows residents’ movements during a 24-hour period within the ‘moat’ in the centre of Gothenburg. The simulation uses a synthetic population based on demographic data (SCB). Data from a traffic analysis (Travel Survey – RVU Trafikanalys, 2017) has been used to assign the synthetic population activities for a day.
SectionObject.Text2: Each coloured line represents an individual who leaves home to carry out their activities. The colours of the lines represent the residents’ chosen mode of transport.                               Visualization: Linköping University , Datageneration DTCC, Chalmers
